task: Add and consume a Raspberry Pi 3 Model B board descriptor without moving SoC facts or duplicating drivers.
acceptanceCriteria: root boards catalog contains QEMU RV64 and Raspberry Pi 3 Model B
UART stays mandatory while PLIC, CLINT, and RTC may be absent
RPi3 identity, VideoCore contract, fallback memory, wiring, and enabled drivers are board-owned
kernel platform and fallback boot paths consume the descriptor
hal/soc/bcm27xx retains immutable SoC facts and shared drivers remain single-copy
publicContracts: RISC-V consumers fail closed when required controller data is missing
no physical Raspberry Pi 3 runtime claim
